limitations: The source manifest has no photoshoot or property boundary.
All advertised-sample, Phase 1 reserved, and Phase 2 development groups are excluded.
Eligible group IDs are ordered by SHA-256 of medium-phase3-dev-v1:<group_id> and greedily assigned to the currently smallest non-overflowing fold until each fold contains 100 images.
Reference-group-disjoint fallback folds do not prove photoshoot- or property-level leakage safety.
